description: This file defines the ClientConnectionOptions class which encapsulates options for client connections in Orleans, providing methods to configure connection delegates and builders.

classes.name: ClientConnectionOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for client connections, including methods to add connection configuration delegates and to configure connection builders.

methods.name: ConfigureConnection
methods.description: Adds a connection configuration delegate to the internal delegate list.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures a provided connection builder using the stored delegates.
